title: heuchera villosa var. macrorhiza
intro: Heuchera villosa var. macrorhiza, commonly known as Coral Bells, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Saxifragaceae family. It is native to North America and is often used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe digestive issues and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Heuchera villosa var. macrorhiza include reducing fever, treating skin conditions, and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
